doc.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

title: Sons' careers and the London Symphony recording
summary: Brubeck describes the new recording with his four sons and the LSO for his 80th birthday, including Darius's 'Four Score In Seven', and plans for his 85th.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Maybe I can just wrap up and ask about your sons’ careers. They seem to be going well.

Oh yeah. There’s a recording, just came out last week in England with four of our sons and the London Symphony Orchestra. So we’ve got the test pressing upstairs. And I’m pleased with it. It was for my 80th birthday. When I was 70 they brought the four sons, when I was 75, the four sons, 80. They bring them from all over the world, because Darius is in South Africa, and Danny and Matthew are in California. Chris is a mile or so from here. And we have a big party in England on my birthday. So this recording has a piece called “Four Score In Seven” by Darius. Four Score meaning my age I think, and Seven is the time signature. And they had one day to rehearse that with themselves, because they just congregated, probably all of them with jet lag, and they rehearsed it and it was very difficult. And in seven. And then the orchestra played it, and they are such great readers. But that’s the kind of thing you wish you had a lot more time to rehearse and play, but it’s on the record and it’s very good. Darius is playing piano. We have two pianos on stage, nine foot grands. And I’m sitting at the other one and I thought if I sit here it’s going to look like I’m playing when this guy’s doing all the work. So I got up and I grabbed an orchestra chair or something that was there so I’m far removed from the piano and it’s Darius doing all the work.
Wanted to give credit where it’s due, huh?
Yeah. Then Russell Gloyd is conducting. Now we’re going back and doing the Easter cantata we’ve decided to do. And the “Upon This Rock” or what we’ll fill out a CD with © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
the London Symphony Orchestra. Easily. We could fill out three or four I think. But that will be in May. And they’ve hired me for my 85th birthday and all the kids.
All right. Everybody’s got it on their calendar. Good, good. You’ll be there.
